name: Ultrasonic Flowmeter Diagnostics
summary: Classification data for four liquid ultrasonic flowmeters covering healthy operation, gas injection, installation effects, and waxing.

attributes.name: profile/flatness factor
attributes.description: Profile factor or flatness ratio describing the flow-velocity profile; naming varies by meter.

attributes.name: swirl_angle
attributes.description: Swirl angle, available only for Meter B.

attributes.name: flow_velocity_1..8
attributes.description: Flow velocity along each path: eight paths for Meter A and four for Meters B through D.

attributes.name: sound_speed_1..8
attributes.description: Speed of sound along each path.

attributes.name: average_flow/speed
attributes.description: Average flow velocity or speed of sound across all paths, available for selected meters.

attributes.name: signal_strength_1..8
attributes.description: Signal strength at both ends of each path for Meters B through D.

attributes.name: turbulence_1..4
attributes.description: Turbulence indicator for each path, available only for Meter B.

attributes.name: meter_performance
attributes.description: Meter-performance indicator, available only for Meter B.

attributes.name: signal_quality_1..8
attributes.description: Signal quality at both ends of each path for Meters B through D.

attributes.name: gain_1..16
attributes.description: Gain at both ends of each path: 16 values for Meter A and eight for Meters B through D.

attributes.name: transit_time_1..8
attributes.description: Transit time at both ends of each path for Meters B through D.

attributes.name: health_state
attributes.description: Healthy, gas injection, installation effects, or waxing; available classes vary by meter.

notes: Meters A through D contain 540 instances in total with no missing values.
Attribute counts and available fault classes vary by meter.
citation: Gyamfi, K. and Marshall, C. (2017). Ultrasonic flowmeter diagnostics. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
